identity.title: LER 2022-001-00 for Prairie Island Nuclear Generating Plant, Units 1 and 2, Fuel Assemblies incorrectly placed in Spent Fuel Pool

cause.proximate_text: an incorrect planning date in the software configuration tool used to plan fuel assembly locations led to 29 fuel assemblies being loaded into locations in the Spent Fuel Pool that did not meet the burnup/enrichment/decay requirements of Technical Specification Design Feature 4.3.1.1
cause.theme: incorrect planning-tool input data leading to fuel mis-placement

nodes.display_name: Incorrect planning date entered in software configuration tool
nodes.description: The planning date used by the software configuration tool to determine acceptable SFP storage locations was incorrect.

nodes.display_name: 29 fuel assemblies loaded into non-compliant SFP locations
nodes.description: Fuel assemblies were placed in Spent Fuel Pool locations that did not satisfy the burnup/enrichment/decay requirements of Technical Specification Design Feature 4.3.1.1.

nodes.display_name: SFP non-compliance with Technical Specification Design Feature 4.3.1.1 / TS 3.7.17 Action Statement A entered
Move 29 non-complying fuel assemblies to acceptable locations
Correct the planning date in the software configuration tool
Revise procedures to require explicit verification of planning date, discharge date, burnup, and enrichment
